name: Laeral’s Silver Lance

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun. Uses the game’s established chosen-area-target convention (enemies).

components.m: a silver pin worth at least 250 GP

summary: A 120-foot Line, 5 feet wide, strikes creatures you choose. Strength save: 3d10 Force and Prone on failure; half damage without Prone on success. Add 1d10 damage per slot level above 3.
